templates.name: Total Revenue - All Time
templates.description: Get total revenue generated across all social media bots
templates.naturalLanguage: What is my total revenue from all social media bots?
templates.sqlTemplate: SELECT SUM(revenue) as total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT botId) as active_bots, COUNT(*) as total_records FROM social_analytics WHERE userId = ?

templates.name: Revenue by Platform
templates.description: Compare revenue across different social media platforms
templates.naturalLanguage: Show me revenue breakdown by platform
templates.sqlTemplate: SELECT b.platform, SUM(a.revenue) as total_revenue, SUM(a.engagement) as total_engagement, SUM(a.posts) as total_posts FROM social_analytics a JOIN social_bots b ON a.botId = b.id WHERE a.userId = ? GROUP BY b.platform ORDER BY total_revenue DESC

templates.name: Top 10 Performing Bots
templates.description: Identify the top 10 bots by revenue generation
templates.naturalLanguage: Which are my top 10 performing bots by revenue?
templates.sqlTemplate: SELECT b.name as bot_name, b.platform, SUM(a.revenue) as total_revenue, SUM(a.engagement) as total_engagement, SUM(a.conversions) as total_conversions FROM social_analytics a JOIN social_bots b ON a.botId = b.id WHERE a.userId = ? GROUP BY b.id, b.name, b.platform ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10

templates.name: Monthly Revenue Trend
templates.description: Track revenue trends over the last 12 months
templates.naturalLanguage: Show me monthly revenue for the last 12 months
templates.sqlTemplate: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', date) as month, SUM(revenue) as total_revenue, SUM(engagement) as total_engagement, SUM(posts) as total_posts FROM social_analytics WHERE userId = ? AND date >= date('now', '-12 months') GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

templates.name: Engagement Rate by Platform
templates.description: Calculate engagement rate for each platform
templates.naturalLanguage: What is the engagement rate for each social media platform?
templates.sqlTemplate: SELECT b.platform, SUM(a.engagement) as total_engagement, SUM(a.reach) as total_reach, ROUND((SUM(a.engagement) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(a.reach), 0)), 2) as engagement_rate FROM social_analytics a JOIN social_bots b ON a.botId = b.id WHERE a.userId = ? AND a.reach > 0 GROUP BY b.platform ORDER BY engagement_rate DESC

templates.name: Conversion Rate Analysis
templates.description: Analyze conversion rates across all bots
templates.naturalLanguage: What are my conversion rates for each bot?
templates.sqlTemplate: SELECT b.name as bot_name, b.platform, SUM(a.clicks) as total_clicks, SUM(a.conversions) as total_conversions, ROUND((SUM(a.conversions) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(a.clicks), 0)), 2) as conversion_rate FROM social_analytics a JOIN social_bots b ON a.botId = b.id WHERE a.userId = ? AND a.clicks > 0 GROUP BY b.id, b.name, b.platform ORDER BY conversion_rate DESC

templates.name: Daily Performance - Last 30 Days
templates.description: View daily performance metrics for the last 30 days
templates.naturalLanguage: Show me daily performance for the last 30 days
templates.sqlTemplate: SELECT date(date) as day, SUM(revenue) as revenue, SUM(engagement) as engagement, SUM(posts) as posts, SUM(clicks) as clicks, SUM(conversions) as conversions FROM social_analytics WHERE userId = ? AND date >= date('now', '-30 days') GROUP BY day ORDER BY day DESC

templates.name: Post Performance by Platform
templates.description: Compare average engagement per post across platforms
templates.naturalLanguage: What is the average engagement per post for each platform?
templates.sqlTemplate: SELECT b.platform, SUM(a.posts) as total_posts, SUM(a.engagement) as total_engagement, ROUND(SUM(a.engagement) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(a.posts), 0), 2) as avg_engagement_per_post FROM social_analytics a JOIN social_bots b ON a.botId = b.id WHERE a.userId = ? AND a.posts > 0 GROUP BY b.platform ORDER BY avg_engagement_per_post DESC

templates.name: ROI by Bot
templates.description: Calculate return on investment for each bot (assuming fixed cost per bot)
templates.naturalLanguage: What is the ROI for each of my bots?
templates.sqlTemplate: SELECT b.name as bot_name, b.platform, SUM(a.revenue) as total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT date(a.date)) as active_days, ROUND((SUM(a.revenue) - (COUNT(DISTINCT date(a.date)) * 10)) / NULLIF((COUNT(DISTINCT date(a.date)) * 10), 0) * 100, 2) as roi_percentage FROM social_analytics a JOIN social_bots b ON a.botId = b.id WHERE a.userId = ? GROUP BY b.id, b.name, b.platform ORDER BY roi_percentage DESC

templates.name: TikTok vs Instagram Performance
templates.description: Compare performance metrics between TikTok and Instagram
templates.sqlTemplate: SELECT b.platform, SUM(a.revenue) as revenue, SUM(a.engagement) as engagement, SUM(a.posts) as posts, SUM(a.impressions) as impressions FROM social_analytics a JOIN social_bots b ON a.botId = b.id WHERE a.userId = ? AND b.platform IN ('tiktok', 'instagram') GROUP BY b.platform

templates.name: Weekly Growth Rate
templates.description: Calculate week-over-week growth in revenue and engagement
templates.naturalLanguage: What is my week-over-week growth rate?
templates.sqlTemplate: SELECT strftime('%Y-W%W', date) as week, SUM(revenue) as weekly_revenue, SUM(engagement) as weekly_engagement, SUM(posts) as weekly_posts FROM social_analytics WHERE userId = ? AND date >= date('now', '-8 weeks') GROUP BY week ORDER BY week DESC

templates.name: Active vs Paused Bots Performance
templates.description: Compare performance of active vs paused bots
templates.naturalLanguage: How do active bots perform compared to paused bots?
templates.sqlTemplate: SELECT b.status, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) as bot_count, SUM(a.revenue) as total_revenue, SUM(a.engagement) as total_engagement FROM social_bots b LEFT JOIN social_analytics a ON b.id = a.botId AND a.userId = ? WHERE b.userId = ? GROUP BY b.status

templates.name: Revenue per Click
templates.description: Calculate average revenue generated per click
templates.naturalLanguage: What is my revenue per click for each platform?
templates.sqlTemplate: SELECT b.platform, SUM(a.revenue) as total_revenue, SUM(a.clicks) as total_clicks, ROUND(SUM(a.revenue) / NULLIF(SUM(a.clicks), 0), 2) as revenue_per_click FROM social_analytics a JOIN social_bots b ON a.botId = b.id WHERE a.userId = ? AND a.clicks > 0 GROUP BY b.platform ORDER BY revenue_per_click DESC

templates.name: Impressions to Engagement Funnel
templates.description: Analyze the funnel from impressions to engagement to conversions
templates.naturalLanguage: Show me the conversion funnel from impressions to engagement
templates.sqlTemplate: SELECT SUM(impressions) as total_impressions, SUM(engagement) as total_engagement, SUM(clicks) as total_clicks, SUM(conversions) as total_conversions, ROUND((SUM(engagement) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(impressions), 0)), 2) as impression_to_engagement_rate, ROUND((SUM(clicks) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(engagement), 0)), 2) as engagement_to_click_rate, ROUND((SUM(conversions) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(clicks), 0)), 2) as click_to_conversion_rate FROM social_analytics WHERE userId = ? AND impressions > 0

templates.name: Bot Activity Timeline
templates.description: View when each bot was most active and generated revenue
templates.naturalLanguage: When were my bots most active?
templates.sqlTemplate: SELECT b.name as bot_name, b.platform, date(a.date) as activity_date, SUM(a.revenue) as daily_revenue, SUM(a.posts) as daily_posts FROM social_analytics a JOIN social_bots b ON a.botId = b.id WHERE a.userId = ? AND a.date >= date('now', '-30 days') GROUP BY b.id, b.name, b.platform, activity_date ORDER BY activity_date DESC, daily_revenue DESC

templates.name: Premium vs Free User Performance
templates.description: Compare average performance between premium and free users
templates.naturalLanguage: How do premium users perform compared to free users?
templates.sqlTemplate: SELECT u.isPremium, COUNT(DISTINCT a.botId) as bot_count, AVG(a.revenue) as avg_revenue, AVG(a.engagement) as avg_engagement FROM social_analytics a JOIN social_users u ON a.userId = u.id GROUP BY u.isPremium

templates.name: Best Performing Day of Week
templates.description: Identify which day of the week generates the most revenue
templates.naturalLanguage: Which day of the week performs best?
templates.sqlTemplate: SELECT CASE strftime('%w', date) WHEN '0' THEN 'Sunday' WHEN '1' THEN 'Monday' WHEN '2' THEN 'Tuesday' WHEN '3' THEN 'Wednesday' WHEN '4' THEN 'Thursday' WHEN '5' THEN 'Friday' WHEN '6' THEN 'Saturday' END as day_of_week, SUM(revenue) as total_revenue, SUM(engagement) as total_engagement, SUM(posts) as total_posts FROM social_analytics WHERE userId = ? GROUP BY strftime('%w', date) ORDER BY total_revenue DESC

templates.name: Recent High Performers
templates.description: Find bots that had exceptional performance in the last 7 days
templates.naturalLanguage: Which bots performed exceptionally well in the last week?
templates.sqlTemplate: SELECT b.name as bot_name, b.platform, SUM(a.revenue) as weekly_revenue, SUM(a.engagement) as weekly_engagement, SUM(a.conversions) as weekly_conversions FROM social_analytics a JOIN social_bots b ON a.botId = b.id WHERE a.userId = ? AND a.date >= date('now', '-7 days') GROUP BY b.id, b.name, b.platform HAVING SUM(a.revenue) > 1000 OR SUM(a.conversions) > 100 ORDER BY weekly_revenue DESC
